emails.invitation.subject: You''re invited to join {tenant}
emails.invitation.body:
Hi {name},

You have been invited to join {tenant}. Accept your invitation here:
{url}

This invitation expires in {days, plural, one {1 day} other {# days}}.
emails.verification.subject: Your verification code
emails.verification.body: Your verification code is {code}. It expires soon.
emails.security_notice.subject: Security notice for your {tenant} account
emails.security_notice.body: We detected the following activity on your account: {detail}.
emails.export_passphrase.subject: Your data export passphrase
emails.export_passphrase.body: Request {request_id}: your export passphrase is {passphrase}. It can be used once.
emails.payment_failed.subject: Payment failed for your {tenant} subscription
emails.payment_failed.body: Your latest payment for {tenant} failed. Please update your billing details to avoid interruption.
emails.subscription_canceled.subject: Your {tenant} subscription was canceled
emails.subscription_restored.subject: Your {tenant} subscription was restored
emails.grace_expired.subject: Your {tenant} subscription has been suspended
emails.grace_expired.body: The payment grace period for {tenant} expired. Update your billing details to restore service.
emails.trial_ending.subject: Your {tenant} trial ends soon
emails.privacy_status.subject: Privacy request update: {subject}
emails.privacy_status.body: Your privacy request status is now {status}.
emails.payments_connection_activated.bod: Your payment account for {tenant} (connection {connection}) can now accept payments from your customers.
emails.payments_connection_restricted.su: Action needed: your {tenant} payment account is restricted
emails.payments_connection_restricted.bo: Your payment account for {tenant} (connection {connection}) cannot accept payments right now: {detail}. Sign in to your dashboard to resolve the outstanding requirements.
emails.payments_requirement_deadline.sub: Deadline approaching for your {tenant} payment account
emails.payments_requirement_deadline.bod: Stripe requires additional information for your payment account (connection {connection}) by {date, date}. If it is not provided, the account will be restricted.
emails.payments_dispute_opened.subject: A chargeback dispute was opened on your account
emails.payments_dispute_opened.body: A customer disputed a payment on your store. Handle dispute {dispute} in the Stripe Dashboard.
emails.payments_dispute_opened.body_due: A customer disputed a payment on your store. Dispute {dispute} needs your response in the Stripe Dashboard by {due, date}.
emails.payments_payout_failed.subject: Action needed: a payout from your {tenant} account failed
emails.payments_payout_failed.body: A payout of {amount} to your bank failed. The money is still held at Stripe - sign in to your Stripe Dashboard to fix the payout details.
emails.payments_tax_lapsed.subject: Action needed: automatic tax may no longer be collecting on your {tenant} store
emails.payments_tax_lapsed.body: Automatic tax is enabled but the tax compliance of the connected payment account has lapsed ({detail}). Tax registration and remittance are your responsibility - consult your tax advisor, then update your registrations in Stripe.
emails.budget_warning_80.subject: Budget warning for {tenant}: 80% threshold reached
emails.budget_warning_80.body: Spend for {scope_name} has reached {spend} (80% of {cap_amount} {period} cap).
emails.budget_cap_breached.subject: Budget cap reached for {tenant}
emails.budget_cap_breached.body: Spend for {scope_name} has reached {spend}, breaching the {period} cap of {cap_amount}. {action_taken}
emails.budget_provisional_warning.body: Provisional spend for {scope_name} is {spend} against a {period} cap of {cap_amount}. The lower bound is {lower_bound}. Campaigns will not be paused on provisional data.
emails.budget_stale_warning.subject: Advertising data staleness warning for {tenant}
emails.budget_stale_warning.body: Metrics data for {scope_name} is currently stale ({lag_hours} hours lag). Guardrails will not pause campaigns on unconfirmed data.
emails.budget_spend_anomaly.subject: Spend anomaly detected for {tenant}
emails.budget_spend_anomaly.body: Unusual spend detected for {scope_name}: current spend is {spend} compared to historical average {average_spend} (>{sigma}σ variance). No automatic actions were taken.
emails.budget_guardrails_rollback.subjec: Notice: advertising budget guardrails feature disabled for {tenant}
emails.budget_guardrails_rollback.body: The advertising budget guardrails feature has been temporarily disabled for {tenant}. Existing caps and alert history are preserved, but automated monitoring and pausing are inactive.
